acceptanceCriteria: The owner confirms the rewrite plan and disables the ruleset for the force-push.
git filter-repo removes only that trailer; the rewritten tree of main is byte-identical.
Every pinned SHA is repinned or its evidence regenerated, and receipt audit, doc checks and the full gate pass on the new main.
Open branches are rebased, the ruleset is restored, and the effect on v0.7.0/v0.8.0 is recorded in BUILD-LOG.
body:
Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Commit ac80244 on main carries `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` (cherry-picked from 366d526, merged in PR #70), which lists the claude account as a repository contributor. It is the only such trailer on main. The owner chose on 2026-09-24 to release 0.8.0 first and rewrite later. Measured blast radius at 444f62c: the `main` ruleset (pull_request, required_status_checks) blocks a direct force-push; 500 of 551 commits get new SHAs; 65 of those SHAs are pinned in 109 tracked files (60 .corvint/changes CEMs, 17 .taskman tickets and the release file, 15 use-case receipts, 10 daily-loop benchmark receipts, docs); v0.7.0 (678c1b1) and v0.8.0 (516439f) contain the commit, and published tags are never moved.

Owner instruction 2026-09-29: remove Claude as a contributor when preparing the 1.0 release. This task is required for v1-0. Reassess the current history and evidence blast radius before proposing the rewrite; the measurements above are historical. This scheduling instruction does not execute or approve a specific force-push plan. Retain the existing rewrite approval, evidence regeneration, published-tag preservation and verification criteria.

2026-09-29 isolated rehearsal identified a concrete N-1 selector blocker: hosted .github/workflows/release-gates.yml:192 uses ancestry-based prior-tag selection and produces no tag on rewritten main while published tags are preserved. Evidence /tmp/corvint-v1-delivery-20260929/history-rewrite/n1-selection-checks.json and N1-PATCH-PLAN.md. An isolated reviewed repair will accept a paired explicit prior tag and exact tag-object identity, retaining default ancestry selection and failing closed on absent, unsafe or stale references. Lifecycle prior-release archive selection is separate from accepted Core v0.8.1 compatibility replay; core-n1-replay is outside make gate. Historical immutable SHA evidence remains historical; do not bulk rewrite references. No specific force-push or publication approved/executed.

2026-09-29: N1 predecessor repair independently reviewed, sealed at 3086a4ca5285a082eed78da159045b7a2cc8ffd0, integrated locally and PR349 pending CI/auto-merge. New owner private-spec/public-consumer requirement V1-0471 supersedes the executable scope of the earlier contributor-only rewrite proposal. Retain its backup method and historical evidence, but do not execute its old main-only lease. Combined approved paths/history/refs scope, fresh rehearsal/maps and exact final approval remain required; historical tag preservation versus historical document removal must be decided explicitly. See /tmp/corvint-v1-delivery-20260929/history-rewrite/PUBLIC-PRIVATE-SCOPE-ADDENDUM.md.
title: 1.0 release: remove Claude as a repository contributor
